documents.population: Applicants to Bachelor's studies (international application via University Admissions in Sweden)
documents.notes: Lund University 'Documentation' page; the application checklist is for studies 'starting in autumn 2027' (application by 15 January, documents by 1 February). Documents go to University Admissions in Sweden (universityadmissions.se, not a Lund domain), which publishes the country-specific document instructions; those were not read. The page states there are no programme-specific documents for Bachelor's studies. Lund's computer-science bachelor (Datateknik) is taught in Swedish. Not drafted: application fee or proof of fee exemption, proof of EU citizenship (fee exemption).

items.quote: You submit all official certificates and transcripts required for your application to University Admissions in Sweden.
when you are applying to Bachelor's studies you must submit your final upper secondary school documents by the document deadline.
All students need to prove that they meet the English requirements. You will in most cases need to demonstrate language proficiency through an internationally recognised test (e.g. IELTS/TOEFL).
items.condition: English proficiency not proved through previous studies in one of the ways universityadmissions.se accepts
